title: SWE-growth: Teacher-Guided Adaptive Self-Play for Software Engineering Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.23876v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Self-play offers a scalable way to train software engineering agents by generating repository-level repair tasks. However, with binary repair rewards and finite rollout budgets, all-fail groups provide no reward-based group-relative advantage. Such tasks may still offer learning opportunities when a Teacher can provide verified repairs absent from the Student's own attempts. We introduce SWE-Growth, a teacher-guided adaptive self-play framework that uses verified Teacher outcomes to identify learning opportunities for the current Student. Tasks with all students failure but reliable Teacher success provide demonstrations for supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and post-SFT Student rollouts identify mixed-outcome tasks with a positive Teacher--Student gap for reinforcement learning. translated_title: SWE-growth：面向软件工程智能体的教师引导自适应自博弈
translated_abstract: 自博弈通过生成仓库级修复任务，为训练软件工程智能体提供了一种可扩展的方式。然而，在二元修复奖励和有限的 rollout 预算下，全部失败的分组无法提供基于奖励的组间相对优势。当教师能够提供学生自身尝试中缺失的、经过验证的修复方案时，这类任务仍然可能提供学习机会。我们提出了 SWE-Growth，这是一个教师引导的自适应自博弈框架，利用经过验证的教师结果来识别当前学生的学习机会。所有学生均失败但教师能可靠成功的任务为监督微调（SFT）提供示范数据，而 SFT 之后的学生 rollout 则识别出具有正向教师-学生差距的混合结果任务用于强化学习。任务资格判定还指导注入器的更新，将学生训练与后续任务生成连接起来。从101个种子问题开始，SWE-Growth 提升（原文在此截断）……
tldr: SWE-Growth 提出了一种教师引导的自适应自博弈框架，利用教师验证的结果识别学生的学习机会——将全失败任务用于 SFT 示范、具有正向师生差距的混合结果任务用于强化学习，并将任务资格判定与注入器更新相连接，实现学生训练与任务生成的闭环协同。
en_tdlr: SWE-Growth introduces a teacher-guided adaptive self-play framework that leverages verified teacher outcomes to identify student learning opportunities—using all-fail tasks as SFT demonstrations and mixed-outcome tasks with positive teacher-student gaps for reinforcement learning, while linking task eligibility to Injector updates to close the loop between student training and task generation.
